purpose: Side view of 40m bridge midspan: girders, cross beam, under-hung frame, springs plus damper plus moving mass; end view shows frame locked to bottom flanges, mass free vertically.
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,4))
ax1.set_title('Side view midspan TMD')
ax1.plot([0,10],[3,3],'k-',lw=3); ax1.text(5,3.3,'deck / girders')
ax1.plot([4,6],[2.2,2.2],'k-',lw=3); ax1.text(4.2,1.9,'support frame (fixed to flange)')
for x in [4.3,5.7]:
    ax1.plot([x,x],[1.2,2.2],'b-'); ax1.text(x-0.2,1.6,'spring')
ax1.plot([5,5],[1.2,2.2],'r--'); ax1.text(5.1,1.6,'damper')
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.2,0.5),1.6,0.7,fc='gray')); ax1.text(4.3,0.7,'moving mass')
ax1.arrow(5,0.5,0,-0.4); ax1.text(5.1,0.2,'motion')
ax1.set_ylim(0,4); ax1.axis('off')
ax2.set_title('End view')
ax2.plot([2,8],[3,3],'k-',lw=4); ax2.text(4.5,3.2,'deck')
ax2.plot([3,3],[2.2,3],'k-',lw=3); ax2.plot([7,7],[2.2,3],'k-',lw=3)
ax2.text(2.2,2.5,'girders'); ax2.plot([2.5,7.5],[2.2,2.2],'k-',lw=3); ax2.text(4,2.3,'cross beam+frame (fixed)')
ax2.plot([4.5,4.5],[1.2,2.2],'b-'); ax2.plot([5.5,5.5],[1.2,2.2],'b-'); ax2.plot([5,5],[1.2,2.2],'r--')
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.2,0.5),1.6,0.7,fc='gray')); ax2.text(4.4,0.7,'mass')
ax2.set_ylim(0,4); ax2.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
